subject: LucentHealth renewal + new RAG/streaming workloads — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@lucenthealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: LucentHealth renewal + new RAG/streaming workloads — post-call recap and next steps

Alex — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap while items are fresh and to confirm next steps on both renewal and the new workloads you described. TL;DR: LucentHealth is a strong renewal opportunity; primary blocker is procurement + SOC2 evidence. New engineering ask is a streaming RAG pipeline and higher-concurrency embedding requests for search.

What we heard (pain & goals):
- Production pain: current latency and token cost spikes when your RAG search fires across long patient notes (esp. midnight batch + peak daytime concurrent queries).
- Goal: reduce 95th-percentile response latency to <400ms for the search path and cut per-query token cost by ~30% vs your current provider.
- Workloads: two additions — (1) streaming ingestion + near-real-time RAG (low-latency prefix reuse), and (2) bulk embedding refresh every 24 hours with burst write throughput.
- Decision timeline: procurement + legal targeting decision by Oct 15; engineering PO expected by Oct 8 to start a 6-week POC.

What Redwood can offer (summary):
- Dedicated pilot capacity (reserved pool) to guarantee latency SLOs; autoscale burst for nightly embedding refreshes.
- Prefix/KV caching + continuous batching to keep per-token cost down on the RAG path.
- SOC2 evidence + architecture notes (attached) and an option for a Private VPC pilot if audit requires network isolation.

Proposed next steps (action owners & dates):
1) Neha: share draft MA/POC proposal + initial pricing bands and projected token model by EOD today (attached: redwood-ma-proposal.pdf).
2) Alex: send rough 30-day token/embedding volume (we requested a sample export) — you agreed to share the usage CSV by Wed, Sep 23.
3) Jordan: schedule a technical kickoff with your infra team the week of Sep 28 (Jordan to propose two slots).
4) Procurement contact loop-in: Alex to include procurement@lucenthealth.com on the MA drafts; Neha will provide SOC2 and support SLAs.

Risks & asks:
- If procurement needs vendor security attestation beyond SOC2 (e.g., custom DPA language), we should surface that by Sep 28 to avoid delay.
- We recommended a short 6-week POC that validates latency SLOs and embedding throughput; if your team prefers a 4-week smoke, flag that now.

Attachments: redwood-ma-proposal.pdf (POC draft & pricing bands), soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 + controls summary).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the proposal and Jordan will drop calendar invites.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

—

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@lucenthealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@lucenthealth.com, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LucentHealth renewal + new RAG/streaming workloads — post-call recap and next steps

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. All accurate from our side. A few clarifications and one ask from procurement:

Clarifications:
- Usage sample: attaching the 30-day export you asked for (lucenthealth-usage-export.csv). It includes token counts for search queries, nightly batch sizes, and embedding requests. Expect the 24-hour embedding refresh to be a large write burst ~180M tokens on peak nights.
- Latency target: the 95th <400ms target is what we want for the clinician-facing UI; backend batch jobs can be >2s.
- Team: I’ll be the internal owner for the POC; Sarah Liu (infra lead) will do technical validation; procurement is cc’d.

Procurement ask:
- They requested evidence of key management controls and a simple DPA template before they will move MA to legal review. Procurement noted they need a short answers summary (1 page) with: data residency options, key rotation, and retention configuration.

Timeline note: we remain on track for an internal decision by Oct 15 but procurement needs materials ASAP. I’ve copied procurement; Sarah will be available for the technical kickoff Sep 29–30.

Attached the usage export for your modeling. Send the one-pager on KM/DPA items and a revised POC timeline and we’ll distribute internally.

Thanks,
Alex Carter
Director, Platform Engineering | LucentHealth
alex.carter@lucenthealth.com
(650) 555-0199

Attachments: lucenthealth-usage-export.csv

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the usage export, Alex — that helps a lot for accurate cost modeling. Two follow-ups based on procurement asks and engineering availability:

1) KM/DPA one pager: attaching a concise 1-page summary addressing key management (KMS integration, rotation cadence), retention controls, and regional data residency options. If procurement wants additional language, loop legal and we can accelerate. (attachment: redwood-km-dpa-onepager.pdf)

2) POC scope & timeline (proposal updates):
- Scope: 6-week POC in Dedicated pilot with reserved pool (we propose 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs during business hours + autoscale for nightly embedding refresh).
- Objectives: validate 95th <400ms for RAG search, validate 180M-token nightly embedding refresh with under 3-hour completion window, and measure per-query cost delta vs your current provider.
- Deliverables: baseline report (week 1), mid-POC perf check (week 3), final SLO report + cost analysis (week 6).
- Proposed start: Oct 11 (engineering PO by Oct 8).

3) Next meetings: Jordan will send two slots for Sep 29–30 for the technical kickoff with Sarah and the infra team. Jordan — please include our solutions engineer and the runtime lead so we can sketch caching/batching config.

4) MA/Commercial: I attached the updated MA/POC draft with pricing bands and an optional Dedicated vs Private comparison (redwood-ma-proposal.pdf). Once procurement confirms DPA language, we can move MA to legal review.

Thanks all — I’ll add the KM one-pager and updated proposal to the Drive folder linked here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3cRedwood-LucentPOC
